$comment: M68: versioned content contract for data/<namespace>/diary/*.json. One file per diary entry. Identity is the resource id namespace + the relative path with the .json suffix stripped (data/mypack/diary/entry_1.json is the diary mypack:entry_1). The parser is Diaries.parseEntry. Two entries claiming the same band or the same display number both drop, the same reject loudly discipline AdventureGraphs uses for a dangling transition; the rejection names every entry involved rather than silently picking one.

version.$comment: Content contract version this file declares. 1 is the only generation this round ships.

number.$comment: Display number. The lodestone reader orders entries by this and it must be unique across the loaded set.

band.$comment: The intensifier band index (AffixMath.intensifierBandIndex) that drops this entry. Must be unique across the loaded set; two entries claiming the same band both drop.

pages.$comment: The canonical, correctly ordered page text the lodestone reader shows. A book's physical page order is shuffled at drop time; this list stays canonical.

unlock_shell.$comment: Optional shell palette id unlocked when this entry is found. A namespaced reference with the same legacy resolution rules as other content ids; omitted or blank means no shell unlock.
